entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help me. I need to return something, a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maya Singh, order number 774-01-B. I received it about 20 days ago.

Thank you, Maya. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken. It's just... I'm really struggling right now, and I really needed this money back for some other things. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I actually tried to return this well within the window, about nine days after I got it.
Okay, and what happened when you tried to process the return then?
Well, that's the problem. I went to the website, but there must have been a huge website error. The whole returns portal was just... broken. It seemed like the entire system was down.
I see. So the portal wasn't loading for you?

Exactly. I tried for an hour. I just couldn't print the return label, nothing would generate. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I was so worried this would be a problem. I feel so stuck.

Maya, thank you so much for that information, and I'm very sorry you had that experience. Let me check our system logs for that period... Yes, I can actually see a notification on my end about a known system down event that affected the returns portal. I sincerely apologize for that failure on our part.
So... can you help me? I was so worried I was just out of luck.

Absolutely. Let me just confirm the policy. Okay, I see here that your item is well within our 90-day return window. Given that, and the website issue you encountered, I can approve this return for you immediately.
Oh, my gosh, really? That's such a relief. You have no idea. Thank you, thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course, I'm happy to get this sorted out for you. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to the address on file. Once we receive the band, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've really helped me out. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Maya. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a wonderful rest of your day.
